featured_reviews.name: sannidhi chowta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful experience at Freedom Tree! The store offers a beautiful and unique collection of furniture, home décor, ceramics, and furnishings. The vibrant colors, creative designs, and attention to detail make every piece stand out.

The staff was friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable, making the entire shopping experience enjoyable. The store ambience is warm and inspiring, with plenty of ideas for creating a stylish and welcoming home.

featured_reviews.name: Amisha Shahra
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience with Freedom Tree. I had bought furniture many years ago and I needed to repair one of the lamps. Harish and Snehal especially went out of their way and were extremely responsive and helpful. It’s rare to find this today. Would definitely encourage you to buy from their store! Good people with great service.

featured_reviews.name: Rhea Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text: I love this store and the collection. The staff is also incredibly helpful and very attentive to your needs! I definitely recommend. :)

featured_reviews.name: seema yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: We wanted to shop some beautifully creative products for our home and a friend recommended the Freedom Tree store. They literally have everything you need for your home. The prints on their Cushion covers and Bedcovers is so stunning and colorful that we fell in love with it. Their dinnerware and drinkware is so modern and elegant, absolutely loved it all. And I don't think any store has better home decor than Freedom Tree. It's just so unique and chic. If you ever go here to shop for your home, checkout their vases and ceramics. It's a hidden gem. And, their furniture is so modern. The best ever place to shop for your home.

featured_reviews.name: Anoshka
featured_reviews.review_text: Freedom Tree is an absolute delight for anyone who loves unique, vibrant, and thoughtfully designed home décor. The store has such a refreshing atmosphere every corner feels like a burst of color and creativity. The quality of their products is top-notch, and you can tell a lot of care goes into each piece.(Bandra)

featured_reviews.name: Atharwa Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: This is such a beautiful store to shop for your home. I'm simply in love with all their home decor and furnishing products. Got a ton of stuff from here. Their designs manage to reflect one's personality. So much in love 🤩🤩

featured_reviews.name: vaibhav mandavkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing store with a pop of color all around  the space. Incredible home furnishings, modern furniture, unique home decor, and newly launched apparel. Must visit home store in Mahalaxmi Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Bombay Magic
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been loving the Freedom tree products for years, the quality is good and they’re insanely attractive. The staff at the store is very friendly, patient and they give very good advice !

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Ingle
featured_reviews.review_text: Happy with overall services... best part is the discounted price and the customization option as per our requirements... they have wide range of colour options and design.. We had done the big resort project with them and happy with their services. Delivery timeline is also fast as they have inhouse manufacturing unit.

featured_reviews.name: arpit varmani
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered 5pcs set for garden . It came via railway with worst packaging i can think of  . Almost all the chairs were damaged.  Cushions and glass top for table were missing. When i asked the railway people they showed me a document that cushions and glass was not even given to them . Since then i am trying to reach the manager pritesh and he has been ignoring my calls.  I would strictly recommend people to stay away from this company if they want to avoid trouble. If you need pictures of the product the way i received feel free to e-mail me.

featured_reviews.name: Heaven World
featured_reviews.review_text: Thanks Designer Furniture team to provide the excellent  service and customised  the sofas and garden set as per my requirements.. Thanks for helping  me out and provided my complete requirements in my budgets and as per what we need for my upcoming resorts at Lonavala... we will surely recomment you to all for Outdoor Furniture.

featured_reviews.name: Vaishnavi Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text: It's such pain to know that the swing you chose & ordered for from an exhibition nearby with so much joy and spent happy times wondering of the day it would finally be at home, doesn't come... Most pathetic people and service.. two months of booking and these people don't even pick up calls and deliberately avoid .. finally I had to travel all the way form navi mumbai to goregoan showroom to take my advance back from them! Extremely disappointed .. No value for customers and their feelings... Kind request to the staff and owner, do not keep your customers in dark.. let them know if you do not have the stock or whatever the reason .. just don't keep them in the illusion that the product would arrive.. atleast we can choose something else and you guys can save your reputation..
